title:
Everything you
need to know.
subline: Check-in, checkout, pools, policies, payments — all in one place.

items.question: What is Check in Check Out Time?
items.answer: Check in is at 10 AM, check out is at 12 Noon.

items.question: Do you allow smoking on property? In the rooms?
Do you offer room service? What are the hours?
items.answer: Yes, we offer In Room Dining 24 hours a day, with a limited overnight menu.

items.question: Do you have a pool?
items.answer: Yes, our two pools are located on our 16th floor rooftop.

items.question: How do I get to the hotel?
items.answer: Please see our Google Maps page for directions.

items.question: I booked on a website other than the hotel website and I need to make a change to my reservation. How do I do this?
items.answer: In this situation, you would have to contact the customer service department at the website you used to make your reservation.

items.question: Will your rooms allow rollaway beds/cribs/playards? Is there a charge?
items.answer: Some of our rooms can accommodate cribs or rollaway beds. There is a per night rental fee for all rollaway beds.

items.question: Is my ID required at check-in?
items.answer: We do require presentation of a valid government-issued identification at the time of check-in.

items.question: Can I check in with my debit card?
items.answer: We absolutely take debit cards at check-in.

items.question: What forms of payment are accepted to pay for my room?
items.answer: All major credit cards are accepted.
